scenarios.name: Inspect the context menu for an Origin axis

scenario_steps.name: a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
Auto-Resize is enabled for the Y Axis in the captured session
the user right-clicks the Y Axis row
a context menu opens beside the axis row
the menu offers Copy, Measure, Visibility and Auto-Resize
Auto-Resize is checked in this session
the corresponding axis is highlighted in the viewport
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the axis row and axis remain highlighted
the user clicks the empty viewport area again
the axis is no longer highlighted in the viewport
the axis row no longer has the filled selection highlight
the axis row retains a focus outline
